title: Graph-of-Thoughts for LLM Causal Discovery with a Fairness-Pathway Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.02877v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Methods that use large language models (LLMs) for causal discovery reason locally, deciding one variable pair or one node at a time, so they never compare alternative whole graphs. We introduce GoT-CD, a Graph-of-Thoughts method that asks an LLM for several complete candidate graphs from variable metadata alone, ranks them with a deterministic validity score, merges them under a hard union constraint, refines the merge, and projects the result to a DAG. We evaluate on Asia, Child, and an Alzheimer's disease graph with 100 samples and GPT-4o-mini. Over five seeds on Alzheimer's and Child, GoT-CD gives the highest mean F1 score and the lowest mean structural Hamming distance of the LLM methods, with 95% intervals of the difference excluding zero in seven of eight comparisons, and it returns a DAG in every run while using three LLM requests per graph. translated_title: 用于大语言模型因果发现的思维图方法：公平性路径案例研究
translated_abstract: 使用大语言模型进行因果发现的方法都是局部推理的，每次只决定一个变量对或一个节点，因此它们从不比较不同的完整图。我们提出GoT-CD，一种思维图方法，它让LLM仅根据变量元数据生成多个完整的候选图，用确定性的有效性评分对它们排序，在硬并集约束下进行合并，对合并结果加以细化，并将结果投影为有向无环图（DAG）。我们在Asia、Child数据集以及一个包含100个样本的阿尔茨海默病图上，使用GPT-4o-mini进行评估。在阿尔茨海默病和Child数据集上的五个随机种子实验中，GoT-CD在各LLM方法中取得了最高的平均F1分数和最低的平均结构汉明距离，八次比较中有七次差异的95%置信区间不包含零，并且它在每次运行中都能返回DAG，同时每个图仅需三次LLM请求。在移除各组件的情况下重放记录的运行结果显示，大部分性能提升归因于
tldr: GoT-CD是一种基于思维图的LLM因果发现方法，它让LLM一次性生成多个完整候选图，并通过确定性评分排序、硬并集约束合并、细化与DAG投影，在多个基准上取得了优于现有LLM因果发现方法的F1分数和结构汉明距离。
en_tdlr: GoT-CD is a Graph-of-Thoughts method that prompts an LLM to produce several complete candidate causal graphs, then ranks, merges, refines, and projects them into a DAG, achieving the best F1 score and lowest structural Hamming distance among LLM-based causal discovery methods across multiple benchmarks.
